title: Building a Marsbase is a Horrible Idea: Let’s do it!
summary: A Kurzgesagt animation walking through how a Mars base could be built and why it would be punishing, covering radiation, temperature extremes, toxic dust and the need for shielding.
why: Recommended as a sobering, accessible overview of the practical challenges of living on Mars.

quote.text: sobering run down of the realities when living on mars
